scope.purpose: independently assess official security fixes as potential real-positive holdout cases for current B/IPC detector families

official_evidence.title: OpenHarmony September 2025 security bulletin
official_evidence.finding: Lists CVE-2025-26474 as an improper input validation vulnerability in communication_ipc; restricted scenarios allow a local attacker to disclose information; Low, CVSS 3.1 3.3; affected OpenHarmony-v5.0.3-Release / communication_ipc 5.0.3.x.

official_evidence.title: Issue IC0KMG: security issue fix
official_evidence.finding: Issue says code review found a collection of fixes: CJ GetReadPosition switched from GetReadableBytes to GetReadPosition; readRemoteObjectArray gained an ArraySize check; float serialization switched to float APIs; IPCSkeleton caller UID/PID changed to live IPC caller values. It shows no linked PR and presents these as an umbrella implementation fix, with no specific exploit, affected data, or impact evidence.

official_evidence.title: Issue IC0GMS: fix interface implementation error
official_evidence.finding: The reported change text duplicates the IC0KMG set. It is not an independent vulnerability case or a second positive.

official_evidence.title: Official fix commit de3a68cc
official_evidence.finding: Commit message is 'fix security issue of cj'. CJ_ReadRemoteObjectArray allocation sizes are corrected from malloc(arrayLength) to malloc(sizeof(element) * arrayLength), and null remote objects are handled. This directly repairs memory safety/input handling in the candidate serialization path.

candidate_cases.label: real_positive_source_level_officially_disclosed
candidate_cases.adjudication: The official OpenHarmony bulletin establishes a real communication_ipc information-disclosure vulnerability, affected product release, attacker class, impact, severity, and CVE identity. The official security-fix commit repairs the under-sized arrays in CJ_ReadRemoteObjectArray (and handles null parcel objects). This is an independently defensible source-positive candidate, unlike the IC0KMG/IC0GMS issue titles alone.

vulnerable_source.commit_relation: direct parent of official security fix commit
vulnerable_source.source_evidence: CJ_ReadRemoteObjectArray checks input length, but allocates int32_t* type and int64_t* id with malloc(arrayLength), then writes one 4-byte and one 8-byte element per element. This under-allocates both buffers; it also dereferences ReadRemoteObject() without a null check.

fixed_source.source_evidence: Allocates sizeof(int32_t)*arrayLength and sizeof(int64_t)*arrayLength; checks null object results before dereference.

family_mapping.mapping_assessment: The disclosed root cause is remote-object-array deserialization allocation-size validation / heap write bounds, with a null-object dereference adjacent in the same fix. The current IPC detector's observed explicit rule IDs include IPC authorization, observer growth and TLV fixed-width parser rules; none directly models this CJ FFI array allocation. Thus this is a valid positive for broad IPC-input / memory-bounds evaluation only if that evaluation explicitly includes general C/C++ memory-safety checks or adds a predeclared rule mapping. Do not count as a TP for existing narrow IPC rule IDs without one.
family_mapping.impact_boundary: Official bulletin supports local information disclosure in restricted scenarios. Product-independent source analysis alone does not establish arbitrary exploitability or a specific disclosure primitive.

candidate_cases.holdout_readiness: candidate_for_locked_holdout_after_detector_identity_and_scope_are_frozen; not yet a scored holdout case
missing_evidence: Freeze and record exact current B/IPC detector, model, parser, and rule-catalog hashes before revealing this candidate to its prediction run.

Bind the scan scope and language/parser eligibility for the Cangjie FFI implementation; if current B IPC rules do not cover it, record not_applicable or evaluate under an explicitly declared memory-safety family.

Verify commit/tree and raw file hashes independently against official Gitee objects at holdout ingestion; this work used a public Gitee clone and independently computed raw Git blob SHA-256, but did not establish product image identity.
A scored case requires a blind/locked prediction record; no prediction was run here.

IC0KMG_IC0GMS_subchange_adjudication.assessment: API semantic correction evidenced; no separate security consequence or vulnerability label established by the issue.

Input validation change alone did not close the allocation bug: the implementation still malloc(arrayLength) for int32_t and int64_t element arrays and then indexes both. The later de3a68cc fix supplies correctly scaled allocations. Do not label the Apr issue's patch as a complete fixed version for this root cause.

IC0KMG_IC0GMS_subchange_adjudication.subchange: ReadFloat/WriteFloat and float arrays use float APIs/types
IC0KMG_IC0GMS_subchange_adjudication.assessment: Serialization type/API correction; no separate security impact or real-positive label established by the issue/advisory.

IC0KMG_IC0GMS_subchange_adjudication.subchange: IPCSkeleton calling UID/PID fetched from live caller context
IC0KMG_IC0GMS_subchange_adjudication.assessment: Corrects identity semantics and may be security relevant, but IC0 issue evidence does not identify a specific authorization failure or consequence. Keep unknown as a standalone label.
Same set of changes and text as IC0KMG; one umbrella issue trail, not a separate sample.

rejected_or_unresolved.case: IC0KMG as a standalone real-positive vulnerability label
rejected_or_unresolved.reason: An issue titled security fix and a code-review description are evidence of a security-oriented change, not enough to adjudicate exploitability, impact, affected product exposure, or which subchange is the vulnerability. It has no linked PR and no specific vulnerability claim.
Description duplicates IC0KMG; counting both inflates independent positives.

holdout_decision.reason: CVE-2025-26474 is a pinned, official source-positive candidate with vulnerable/fixed commit pair and raw hashes, but a frozen detector identity/scope plus a locked prediction record are not present in this adjudication. The candidate can support a future independent holdout once those controls are bound.
